description: This file declares the VP8OnlyEncoderFactory class, which is a specialized implementation of the webrtc::VideoEncoderFactory interface for creating VP8 encoders within the WebRTC streaming context. It provides methods to get supported formats, create video encoders, and retrieve an encoder selector.

classes.name: VP8OnlyEncoderFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating VP8 video encoders, implementing the webrtc::VideoEncoderFactory interface.

methods.name: VP8OnlyEncoderFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with an inner VideoEncoderFactory.

methods.name: GetSupportedFormats
methods.description: Returns a list of supported SDP video formats for VP8 encoding.

methods.name: CreateVideoEncoder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new VideoEncoder for the specified SDP video format.

methods.name: GetEncoderSelector
methods.description: Returns an encoder selector interface, possibly for selecting among multiple encoders.
